text: AI is changing the way we think about creativity. Today, AI tools can create art, compose music, and even write stories or articles. These tools learn from huge amounts of data and can produce surprising results in seconds. However, many people believe that human creativity is different. Humans create from emotions, personal experiences, and imagination, while machines simply recognize patterns and follow instructions. AI can support artists and writers by offering new ideas, but it cannot feel or truly understand what it makes. In the end, AI is a powerful tool, but human creativity remains at the heart of art.
